notes.title: SONOKUNI - Gallery Update available now!
notes.notes:
[p]We're excited to announce a new free content update to SONOKUNI! From today, you can dig deep into a vast collection of artwork, design notes, and music tracks as part of a new Gallery Mode. [/p][p]Boot up the game from today and you'll find a new option down at the bottom of the main menu. Select that and you'll get to peek behind the curtain to see how the final designs of SONOKUNI came to be, from time-bending power-wielding protagonist Takeru, to the bizarre biotech beings she battles against in her quest for vengeance.
[/p][p]Also included are a collection of music tracks from the game, giving players a chance to aurally drink in the eclectic Japanese hip hop tones of Don Yasa Crew while taking a break from the blood pressure-raising carnage of the main game.
[/p][p]And to celebrate this update - and the critical warmth the game has received since its launch earlier this year - there’s a new Accolades trailer! Check it out below![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CxtlczY8g7g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We've been bowled over by the positive response to SONOKUNI so far! As always though, we're keen to hear your feedback - feel free to share your thoughts on the game (or y'know, just give us a follow to find out what we're cooking next) via our socials ([u][url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fkakehashi_games"]Twitter / X[/url][/u] | [u][url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fkakehashigames.com"]Bluesky[/url][/u] | [u][url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40kakehashi.games"]TikTok[/url])[/u], or via Steam Discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]Many Thanks,[/p][p][/p][p]Kakehashi Games[/p]

notes.title: SONOKUNI now 'Verified' for Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A quick note to let you know that Valve has completed its assement of SONOKUNI on Steam Deck and as you can see it has come out of the other side of that process with a shiny new 'Verified' badge!

We knew SONOKUNI would run just fine on the Steam Deck (we've been playing and testing it ourselves on the device for a long time prior to launch), but to have the stamp of approval from Valve is a nice slap on the back we thought worth celebrating!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/09ed62ff46dbc6154ff07b8999b4a1d373a8c766.jpg[/img]

Whatever device you're playing on: thank you for giving SONOKUNI a try! We hope this 'Verified' badge inspires you to take SONOKUNI with you on your next commute!

Many thanks,

Kakehashi Games

notes.title: SONOKUNI | Patch notes for 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Before we get into the details of this 1.0.2 patch for SONOKUNI, we just wanted to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has picked up the game and especially to those who have left such awesome feedback. It's been just over a week since launch and we've been blown away by the positive responses (and head bopping emojis).

All that said, if you do have any additional feedback to share, or if you do run into any issues at all, please do feel free to share them with us, either by responding to this post, or by heading to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2054380/discussions/]Steam Discussions board[/url]. We are reading everything and every little bit of feedback, no matter how small, helps us improve the game!

Speaking of help, if you haven't already, please do consider leaving SONOKUNI a review on Steam. Getting reviews early doors makes a big difference for plucky hip hop indie games.

Read on for the patch notes!

Many thanks,

Kakehashi Games

notes.title: SONOKUNI out now!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the Japanese hip hop biopunk action of SONOKUNI is available right now via Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054380/SONOKUNI/

[previewyoutube=1_a0bCqk6WQ;full][/previewyoutube]


In SONOKUNI, you'll take on the role of Takeru, a lone assassin tasked with raiding a surreal superpower empowered by biotechnology. Join in her struggle to balance the morality of extreme violence against the defence of her own people, in a story inspired by real-life Japanese mythology (with every moment punctuated with a visceral soundtrack from Japanese developer and hip hop group, Don Yasa Crew).

Can’t get enough of SONOKUNI's ear-bleeding aural soundscape? Then we have some more good news:

The [b]SONOKUNI Deluxe Edition[/b] is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51600/SONOKUNI_Deluxe_Edition/]also available via Steam[/url], and it includes the game alongside its 50-track strong soundtrack. Every single one of the bangers within is composed by the hip hop crew-turned-developer, Don Yasa Crew, themselves.

Are you ready to deliver vengeance? Grab your headphones and pick up the game now!

Many thanks,

The Kakehashi Games Team

notes.title: Updated demo live now (with new 'Speedrun' mode) - plus new track revealed!

For anyone that caught it, you might have spotted (and you definitely heard) Sonokuni during the PC Gaming Most Wanted Showcase 2024! During the show we revealed a new trailer showing some more gameplay and side-on sections, as well as a brand new track from the game.

Check out that new trailer right here:

[previewyoutube=_bLXaR2ZKsk;full][/previewyoutube]

And you can check out the sick new track from Don Yasa Crew in full via YouTube here:

[previewyoutube=VKQg_ND27nI;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside this trailer we’ve also pushed an updated playable demo live to Steam which you can jump into right now, here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054380/SONOKUNI/

Alongside the above announcements, we’re also revealing a brand new ‘Speedrun’ mode which will be included with the game at launch. For those of you looking for an extra challenge, this mode will have you operating at the bleeding edge of your abilities. Check out the demo for an early look at this new mode in a challenging ‘mirrored’ version of the available stages!

Whenever we have brought the game to physical events like Bitsummit, Tokyo Games Show and EGX this is one feature we’re asked about all the time, so we’re especially excited to be able to bring this to the game in time for launch.

It’s not too long to wait now, with just polish and some finishing touches to work on on our side. We can’t wait for you to get the game in your hands (and in your ears) in early 2025.

Until then, be sure to wishlist Sonokuni if you haven’t already (every wishlist helps!).

Thanks all,

The Kakehashi Games team

notes.title: Dev update: New track, level transitions, localisations (and new launch window)
notes.notes:
It’s been a busy few months but while we have a little bit of breathing room we wanted to jump into your Steam news feeds with a few updates on Sonokuni, both on development progress and some other news too.

[h1]Summer adventures[/h1]

Over the Summer we took Sonokuni to Bitsummit, where it won two (!) awards: [b]Excellence in Sound Design[/b] and [b]VGC’s Media Highlight Award[/b]. Sonokuni was also playable on the show floor at Tokyo Games Show.

We wanted, first and foremost, to send out a huge [b]‘thank you’[/b] to everyone who came along to the Kakehashi Games booths at these events and played the game. It was awesome to get some direct feedback (and of course great to see heads bopping along to the beat!).

[h1]Laying down tracks[/h1]

Back at Don Yasa Crew HQ, the development team x J-hip hop crew has been busy implementing a lot of new things in the game. Not least a bunch of new tracks for the later levels.

Check out 'DO', one of these new tracks in full below - headphones/full volume recommended:

[previewyoutube=VKQg_ND27nI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Getting around[/h1]

Don Yasa Crew are keen to show a little more of the surrounding world of the game outside of the titular village of ‘Sonokuni’ and the neighbouring country of ‘Wanokuni’ (where the stages take place). With this in mind they have now added a characteristically psychedelic array of transition sequences. The aim here is to gently hint at the state of the world outside of these two main locations. We hope you find these sequences intriguing and a little surprising!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/bf34b3c1505c4fc0c7c021ea1ba56ba8c59967b7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/0e1fad515cc3bf7fba2208834a08a53c178e21f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Translations inbound[/h1]

One of the questions we are most asked is whether Sonokuni will be fully localised into XYZ language. We’re happy to give you a little peek behind the curtain at the localisation progress being made. The current ‘in development’ build is now playable in [b]English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/154549f3f11d3290d2e9b542abf7184fff339d11.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/173b1d879e58c09083be40d71280bf047a61adf4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598993/80cb5c3535570ac20d2879490a3f45e67c43e491.png[/img]

[h1]Launch window update[/h1]

A key thing we wanted to tell you about as well is that, while development is coming along really well so far, [b]we’ve made the decision to shift the expected launch window back into early 2025.[/b] 

We were previously aiming to have Sonokuni in your hands by the end of this year, but after having so many people playing the game during the various events and the Steam Next Fest demo earlier in the year, we’ve received [i]so much awesome feedback[/i] it would be a shame not to include in the final game due to time constraints.

We’re sorry to have to push the release back like this, though we’re confident that this is the right thing to do to ensure we have all the time needed to create the best, most well-balanced, and polished version of Sonokuni possible.

***

Thanks for taking the time to read through this update, and for your interest in Sonokuni! Please do consider wishlisting if you haven’t already (this stuff really does help!). And of course keep an eye out - and an ear open - for more updates.

The Kakehashi Games Team
